_doc: The program and model each Chief of Staff role starts with, read by `cos exec <role>` (every Herdr template's command). Change a role's model here, nowhere else. Choose by orchestrate's references/models.md: Opus for judgment and code, Haiku for read-only research, Sonnet for mechanical checks, and the reviewer from a different model family than the code's author. `cos models` prints this table.

chief-of-staff.why: routes and summarises; low effort keeps the always-on agent cheap

lead.why: plans a project and judges its workers' results

tester.why: runs the app and captures screenshots

reviewer.why: a second model family reviews Claude's code
